Your HTV keeps peeling and you're about to lose it. 😤

Before you blame the vinyl — check these 6 things:

1️⃣ Temperature — is it ACTUALLY what your press says?
2️⃣ Pre-press — 3 seconds removes hidden moisture
3️⃣ Pressure — firm and even (most people press too light)
4️⃣ Time — use a timer, don't eyeball it
5️⃣ Peel temp — hot peel vs cold peel matters!
6️⃣ Teflon sheet — replace it when it gets crinkly

I wasted SO much vinyl when I started. 🥲

Here are 5 mistakes every Cricut beginner makes (so you don't have to):

❌ Forgetting to mirror HTV — backwards text every time
❌ Wrong blade — fine point ≠ deep cut
❌ Skipping the test cut — one small square saves whole sheets
❌ Wrong mat — pink mat will DESTROY cardstock
❌ Guessing pressure — use the Cricut pressure guide!

🌈 Infusible Ink → permanent color on Cricut blanks
✨ Glitter HTV → sparkly shirts & accessories
🎨 Printable vinyl → full-color stickers & designs
